# MakeHuman CC0 facial geometry

`base.obj` and `caucasian-male-young.target` are MakeHuman bundled art assets, released under CC0 1.0 Universal. The Hide iT generator uses the facial surfaces and adult morph to model the head and neck. The character's clothing, textures, hair, and rig are authored for Hide iT.

- [Upstream asset license](https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman/blob/a8bc2d54ff0ac92e78ff71431b1023eda42bf482/LICENSE.md#c-the-license-for-the-bundled-assets)
- [Base geometry](https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman/blob/a8bc2d54ff0ac92e78ff71431b1023eda42bf482/makehuman/data/3dobjs/base.obj)
- [Morph data](https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman/blob/a8bc2d54ff0ac92e78ff71431b1023eda42bf482/makehuman/data/targets/macrodetails/caucasian-male-young.target)
